statusReason: 五项门禁全过：单测 124/0（42 格、重力、先手交替、21+21 枚、四方向连线、满盘平局、AI 合法性）；双客户端联机 E2E 83/0 并输出 ONLINE_E2E_JSON；浏览器 E2E 150/0 并写入 perf.json（FCP 0ms、DCL 32ms、DOM 207、FPS 61、新局 0.2ms、materialBytes 400553、外部请求 0）；封面 1200×1200、OG 1200×630、两张详情图 1200×800 由本地材质代码合成，四图+四材质合计 625456 bytes；realism 七类校验通过；390×844 与 320×568 冒烟 PASS（19 项检查/档，零 console error、零外部请求、零溢出、主控件 ≥44px、字号 ≥12px、320 档棋盘列宽 44px）。

e2e.environment: dedicated resident headless Chrome via CDP 9332 (persistent profile, reused across runs); chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 2 人联机（AI 补位）· 单人红方 vs 简单 / 普通 / 困难 AI

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 2 seats; room id + single-use invite token + optional password
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/connect4-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; every viewer receives the same public board, turn and winning line
features.aiFill: an empty seat is filled by the same engine's hard AI; the server applies its pure action
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for 15s → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores the human
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=connect4-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the action guard
features.rematch: host restart swaps the first player: seat 1 becomes red, seat 0 becomes yellow

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.shuffle: games/shared/shuffle.js — loaded by index.html; Connect 4 needs no shuffling, so only the shared module is present
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html script tag; no per-game AudioContext
shared.rules: N/A — Connect 4 rules live in engine.js (the single implementation used by UI, AI and server)
shared.physics: Gravity is deterministic (lowest empty cell); no physics engine
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

rules.gravity: lowest empty cell of the chosen column
rules.win: 4 connected horizontally, vertically or on either diagonal
rules.draw: 42 cells full with no four connected
rules.terminal: no legal moves after a win or a draw
